description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldRelate class, which extends SugarWidgetReportField to provide functionalities for rendering related field inputs and filters in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM dashboards, including generating HTML select elements, building database queries for filtering, and rendering list view links.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldRelate
classes.description: A widget class for handling related field inputs and display in reports and dashlets within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Returns the HTML select element for choosing related records in configuration dashboards.

methods.name: displayInputQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch options for the relate input select element.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Generates a SQL filter condition for selecting records where related IDs start with certain values.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Generates a SQL filter condition for selecting records related to a set of IDs.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns plain list view display of related record name, suitable for CSV or PDF export.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Returns HTML for the list view cell, including a link to the detailed record view.
